title: Rate-Type Eligibility Concrete Test Results
purpose: Record concrete pass, fail, and edge-case adversarial traces for RATE_TYPE_ELIGIBLE(x, phi) without promoting RATE_UNIFICATION_001 or DENSITY_BRIDGE_001.
summary: This patch records one pass, one fail, and one edge-case result for RATE_TYPE_ELIGIBLE(x, phi). The records are diagnostic only: eligibility is not validation, and no bridge claim is promoted.

basis.scope: Provisional results witness that records concrete rate-type eligibility outcomes while keeping RT_core unchanged and leaving bridge promotion deferred.

core_rule.statement: Concrete rate-type eligibility results may be recorded only after phi is declared and the candidate is evaluated under the governed predicate; PASS, FAIL, and EDGE remain diagnostic result classes and do not promote any bridge claim or modify RT_core.

ResultCounterexample.definition: A governed counterexample witness that blocks any reading in which eligibility becomes validation or bridge promotion.

formal_reading.interpretation: The recorded results are diagnostic governance artifacts. PASS admits further bridge testing, FAIL records generative exclusion, and EDGE preserves unresolved admissibility under the declared phi.

governance_rules.rule: Concrete RATE_TYPE_ELIGIBLE(x, phi) results are admissible only when phi is declared before evaluation.
A PASS result admits further bridge testing but does not promote RATE_UNIFICATION_001, DENSITY_BRIDGE_001, or any physical, probabilistic, statistical, or entropic bridge claim.
A FAIL result must preserve its failure class as generative exclusion evidence rather than treating failure as mere absence.
An EDGE result must remain unresolved unless a later patch either promotes it to PASS through explicit derivation or demotes it to FAIL through a recorded failure class.

non_claims: Does not assert external physical truth.
Does not define a completed metric.

concrete_tests.reference_phi: phi_phys := declared propagation-reference frame for bounded coupled continuation
concrete_tests.interpretation: The candidate remains inside the coupled interior and is eligible for rate-typed bridge testing.
A true 0 DOF decoupled endpoint cannot be rate-typed because no coupled continuation remains available for rate evaluation.

concrete_tests.candidate_x: Near-tie distinction-density candidate below declared admissibility floor
concrete_tests.interpretation: The candidate is not a clean failure because coupled structure remains present, but it is not a clean pass because the declared phi places the near-tie below admissible resolution. This preserves CP001 as test-relevant rather than promoted.
